name: Autoquote3D
description:
AutoQuote3D is instant-quoting and order-management software for 3D printing service bureaus, used by 100+ print shops. This connector gives Claude secure, authenticated access to your shop so you can run it in plain English instead of clicking through a dashboard.
With it connected, you can:
Build and send quotes — create a quote, upload STL/OBJ/STEP/3MF part files, configure material, layer height, infill, color, and quantity per line item, then price it and email the customer a checkout link.
Manage your catalog and pricing — add or edit materials and their options across FDM, SLA, SLS, MJF, and DMLS, set machine build volumes and minimum prices, and audit the catalog for unusable materials or missing pricing.
Configure commercial rules — discount codes, quantity-tier bulk discounts, rush/urgency options, shipping methods, and add-on upsells.
Run the order pipeline — list and inspect orders, move them through fulfillment states, leave internal staff notes, and pull up the action center for anything awaiting attention.
Understand performance — revenue and order trends, quote-to-order conversion, popular materials, and customer lifetime value.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Autoquote3D to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Autoquote3D to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.mcp.autoquote3d.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Autoquote3D MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Autoquote3D lists 58 MCP tools, including add_material_options, add_or_update_quote_items, archive_bulk_discount, archive_discount, archive_material_options, archive_quote, archive_shipping_method, archive_upsell, archive_urgency_option, audit_catalog, create_bulk_discount, and create_discount.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Autoquote3D?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Autoquote3D in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Autoquote3D requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Autoquote3D is developed by Autoquote3D. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
